settings.title: Studio Data Backup
settings.description: Bundle the entire studio database plus images into a single ZIP. Use it to fully restore when needed.

frequency.label: Automatic backup frequency
frequency.description: Production will generate a new backup at this cadence. Local development changes will not trigger anything immediately.

reminder.never: Heads up: you have never downloaded a backup to your machine. Pull one now.
reminder.overdue: Heads up: it has been {{days}} days since you last downloaded a backup. Pull one now.

import.tabDescription: Markdown Import ingests artworks from a Markdown file; Restore from Backup overwrites the entire studio dataset from a ZIP.

upload.dropzone: Click or drop a backup ZIP here
upload.fileType: Only .zip files generated by this studio's backup are supported

diff.title: Overwrite diff
diff.warning: Restore will delete all current data first, then insert backup contents.

rollback.title: Download a rollback bundle before restoring
rollback.explanation: Restore is destructive: it wipes current data first, then writes backup contents. Pack a snapshot of your current state to your machine first — you can use it to undo if restore fails.

confirm.label: Type {{token}} to unlock the restore button

result.rollbackHint: Use the rollback bundle you just downloaded to revert to the pre-import state. Contact support if you need help.

errors.cross_account: This backup belongs to a different account and cannot be imported here.
errors.schema_mismatch: Backup DB version is not compatible. Current {{expected}}, backup {{got}}.
errors.format_mismatch: Backup ZIP format is not compatible. Current v{{expected}}, backup v{{got}}.
errors.rollback_required: Please download a rollback bundle of the current state before restoring.
errors.no_backup: No valid backup contents in the ZIP.
errors.invalid_zip: Not a valid backup ZIP file.
